授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 流体力学の基礎知識を習得する．
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Fluid mechanics is a fundamental subject of aeronautical and mechanical engineering. Fluid mechanics deals with the flow of fluids, i.e. liquids and gases, and describes the mechanics and dynamics of fluids as one example of continuum mechanics. This course is the second course of fluid mechanics, in which students will begin to solve the governing equations for special cases, including
potential flow and simple viscous flow solutions, while other topics, including turbulence and drag, will be treated largely from an empirical perspective.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Fluid mechanics, laminar flow, turbulent flow, boundary-layer flow, viscous drag, potential flow
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
This course begins where Fluid Mechanics I ends and uses Newtonian mechanics
along with calculus and vector analysis to elucidate various fluid phenomena.
As a minimum, you are expected to have taken and passed Calculus I,II, III and IV
before taking this course.
If you have not passed Calculus I-IV, but still wish to take  Fluid Mechanics II then please
contact WALL (
wall@aero.kyushu-u.ac.jp
) before the course commences.
